summary: Android app that carries TAK Cursor-on-Target traffic (PLI, GeoChat, point markers, emergency alerts) over analog VHF/UHF radios using a software Bell 202 AFSK modem with optional FX.25 error correction. Acts as a local TCP TAK server for ATAK; no ATAK plugin.

architecture.pattern: Pure-Kotlin core library + thin Android shell. Manual constructor wiring (AppContainer), no DI framework. UI is single-activity Jetpack Compose reading StateFlows. The gateway runs in a foreground service on plain threads.
rules: :core has no Android imports; all protocol/modem/crypto/scheduling logic and all unit tests live there
:usbserial is vendored third-party source; do not edit
Over-air format changes must follow docs/PROTOCOL.md versioning rules
RF traffic is never retransmitted except by store-and-forward relaying of chat, markers and emergency alerts (opt-in, single hop, rate-limited; docs/PROTOCOL.md section 9)
PTT must be released in finally blocks, on service destroy, on USB detach and by the TX watchdog; when the Bluetooth PTT link drops, transmitting is disabled and audio aborted

ax25.responsibility: AX.25 addresses and UI frames, CRC-16-CCITT FCS, HDLC flags/bit stuffing, NRZI, FX.25 framing (correlation tags, encoder, bit-level receiver) and the Reed-Solomon codec (GF(2^8) 0x11D, fcr 1; Dire Wolf compatible)

modem.responsibility: Bell 202 AFSK 1200 baud at 48 kHz: modulator (plain or FX.25), multi-slicer demodulator with PLL, an HDLC deframer and an FX.25 receiver per slicer, CRC de-duplication, fecRecovered counter, DCD, level meter, FIR design

codec.responsibility: Over-air binary payload (PLI/Chat/Marker/Emergency), field encodings and caps, the extension byte (hop count, age, PLI report counter), payload encryption suites and key loading
codec.notes: PayloadCrypto.kt holds PayloadCipher, AeadCipher (suites 0/1), EciesCipher (suites 2/3), KeyLoader (passphrase, key files, PEM, ECDH, HKDF). PacketCodec.encode(hiddenSource=) writes a version-1 hidden-source packet (station address sealed after the type byte; refuses without a cipher); decode returns it as DecodeResult.Ok.hiddenSource. Encrypting codecs always reserve Wire.HIDDEN_SOURCE_MAX_SIZE in chats.

cot.responsibility: CoT XML: hardened parsing (including the <emergency> detail), stream splitting on </event>, classification of client events (b-a-* alerts become EmergencyMessage), rebuilding XML for RF traffic

sched.responsibility: Injected clock, PLI scheduler, priority TX queue (alerts > chat > markers > PLI), loop guard, p-persistent CSMA, time-slot schedule and channel access, geo helpers, store and forward (RepeatConfig limits, RepeatStore, SeenCache, and their binary save/restore via HeldMessageIo), EmergencyBeacon (repeats own active alerts every 30 s, cancel 3 times)

stats.responsibility: Rolling 10-minute channel statistics in 10 s buckets: channel busy, own air time, RX/TX event counts (ChannelEvent), snapshot as ChannelHealth

radio.responsibility: RadioGuide: advice-only band plan data and rules for the radio guide. RadioService (AMATEUR/BUSINESS), Band (VHF/UHF), ChannelWidth (NARROW/WIDE with peak and data deviation), Terrain; recommendedBand and reasons per terrain, FX.25 suggestion, terrain tips, radio checklist for data, suggested and to-avoid frequencies (ARRL 2 m packet channels, 70 cm 445-447 local option, Part 90 itinerant channels from 47 CFR 90.35). US rules only. Business band is always NARROW (effectiveWidth)

profile.responsibility: TeamProfile: the team-wide settings as a takwave://profile?... link (also file and QR content); strict validation, slot assignment table, never key material

gateway.responsibility: I/O-free heart of the app: client CoT -> queue -> AX.25 frames, and RF frames -> CoT; optional hideSource (AX.25 source Gateway.HIDDEN_SOURCE = TAKWV-15, real address inside the ciphertext; receive uses the inner address as source everywhere); heard-station table with PLI loss from report-counter gaps; heard alerts and own alerts; RxKind on every RF outcome for statistics; feeds RepeatStore and emits re-sent/relayed frames (TxKind) when the queue is empty; saveState/restoreState for store-and-forward persistence

io.responsibility: Boundary interfaces (AudioSink, AudioSource, Ptt, FrameTransport with lastAirtimeMs), the two transports (soft modem with optional FX.25 transmit), and the parser for operator-typed PTT command strings

datapackage.responsibility: Builds the ATAK mission-package zip that configures the server connection

(root).responsibility: Application class, manual wiring (AppContainer also holds StateFile and pendingProfile), single activity: shows the setup guide until Settings.onboardingDone, then Status as home with a saveable back stack of Screen entries (Settings, its pages, Calibrate, Log, About) and a SaveableStateHolder keeping scroll state; accepts takwave://profile links (onCreate/onNewIntent) and shows ProfileImportDialog for any pending profile

data.responsibility: Settings model (including Fx25Mode and the radio guide choices radioService/radioBand/channelWidth/terrain, which the gateway never reads; effectiveChannelWidth) and DataStore persistence; imported key files and cipher construction; Settings <-> TeamProfile mapping and change list; store-and-forward state file (AtomicFile in noBackupFilesDir)

engine.responsibility: RadioEngine wires CotServer + Gateway + transport and owns the tx/status threads, feeds ChannelStats, restores and saves store-and-forward state; RadioStatus (alerts, channel health) and PacketLog state holders

service.responsibility: Foreground service (microphone|connectedDevice), notification, wake lock, USB-detach handling

net.responsibility: Local TCP CoT server (default port Settings.DEFAULT_TAK_PORT 8099; 8087 = ATAK's own input, refused and migrated, DECISIONS 103); share-sheet export of the data package, team profile and log

audio.responsibility: AudioRecord/AudioTrack implementations of AudioSource/AudioSink, audio device enumeration, AudioDevices.hasUsbAudio (any USB sound card attached)

ptt.responsibility: Serial RTS/DTR PTT through usb-serial-for-android, USB permission requests; Bluetooth serial (SPP) PTT that writes key/unkey commands to a paired device

ui.notes: Theme.kt holds Section (optional info button) and InfoButton. Scrollbar.kt provides Modifier.verticalScrollbar(ScrollState | LazyListState); every scrolling surface uses it, placed before verticalScroll. SettingsScreen.kt: SettingsScreen is the list of SettingsPage groups (STATION: station, TAK server, PLI, team profile; RADIO: modem backend, audio, PTT, transmit, Calibrate levels button; CHANNEL: FX.25, CSMA, time slots, store and forward; SECURITY: encryption) with summaries; SettingsPageScreen renders one page; SettingsColumn adds the restart card on every settings screen. It also exposes the setting widgets and AudioDeviceSettings / SerialPttSettings / BluetoothPttSettings as internal composables reused by OnboardingScreen.kt. SerialPttSettings takes onUseVox: when no serial adapter but a USB sound card is attached (auto-PTT cable such as the BTECH APRS-K1 PRO) it shows a hint and a 'Use VOX instead' button (Settings: pttMethod VOX + TXDELAY >= VOX_MIN_TX_DELAY_MS; setup guide: switches RadioSetup to VOX_CABLE, landing on the Transmit step). RadioEngine adds the same hint to the 'Serial PTT unavailable' warning. HelpText.kt holds every info-dialog text. StatusScreen.kt shows alert cards, the Channel health section and PLI reception per heard station. TeamProfileUi.kt holds TeamProfileSection (Settings), the share dialog with a ZXing-drawn QR code, and ProfileImportDialog. AboutScreen.kt shows the version (from PackageManager; buildConfig is off), developer, and links (repository, issues, Buy Me a Coffee) opened with ACTION_VIEW only on tap; the URLs are constants at the top of the file. Navigation (MainActivity): no tab row. StatusScreen is home; top bar IconButtons open Log (ic_log), Settings (ic_settings) and About (ic_about); other screens show a back arrow (ic_back) and BackHandler pops the stack. CalibrateScreen opens from Settings > Radio & audio and from 'Adjust levels' in the Status Radio card (StatusScreen onCalibrate); it takes Settings to show the deviation target for effectiveChannelWidth. RadioGuideScreen (Screen.RADIO_GUIDE) opens from the 'Radio guide' section at the top of the Radio & audio page (SettingsPageScreen onRadioGuide); it renders core RadioGuide.advise for the stored choices, warns when encryption is on with the amateur service, links to Calibrate, and can set the suggested FX.25 mode. Labels for the core radio enums and Settings.radioGuideSummary live in RadioGuideScreen.kt; info text HelpText.RADIO_GUIDE. Icons are app vector drawables; no icon library (docs/DECISIONS.md 60).

:usbserial.responsibility: usb-serial-for-android v3.9.0, MIT, unmodified. See usbserial/VENDORED.md

:xmlparser.responsibility: kXML 2 jar minus org/xmlpull/** so R8 accepts it alongside the Android platform's XmlPull API

clientToRadio: cot/CotParser.parse (hardened) -> cot/CotMapper.classify (PLI / chat / marker / ping / drop)
sched/LoopGuard check -> PLI: sched/PliScheduler.update; chat & markers: sched/TxQueue.offer
RadioEngine.transmitLoop -> Gateway.pollFrame (scheduler.due -> queue.poll -> codec/PacketCodec.encode [+ PayloadCipher.seal] -> ax25/Ax25Frame.encode)

io/FrameTransport.send: SoftModemTransport (sched/ChannelAccess: CSMA or time slot -> Ptt.key -> modem/AfskModulator -> AudioSink -> Ptt.unkey in finally) or KissTcpTransport (kiss/Kiss.encode -> TCP)
radioToClient: modem/AfskDemodulator (filters, slicers, PLL) -> ax25/HdlcDeframer (unstuff, FCS check) -> FrameListener
cot/CotBuilder (adds <__takwave rx="1"/>) -> net/CotServer.sendToAll -> every TAK client
dataFlows.clientRelay: CotServer -> RadioEngine.onClientEvent -> CotServer.sendToAll(except sender) for every valid non-ping event
storeAndForward: Own traffic: Gateway.pollFrame sends a queued chat/marker -> RepeatStore.onOwnSent (records stations in range)

RF: Gateway.onRfFrame -> codec extension (DecodeResult.Ok.hops, ageS) -> originMs = now - age -> SeenCache.accept (NEW / REPEAT / OUTDATED marker version; only NEW is delivered) -> CotBuilder uses originMs for event time and chat remarks time, stale from now -> RepeatStore.onRf (cancels pending repeat; relay stations hold messages heard from their author) -> RepeatStore.onStationHeard (schedules repeats for stations not covered; direct chats only for the recipient via uidSource)

Gateway.pollFrame, queue empty -> RepeatStore.nextDue (hold time, repeats per message, min gap, 10-minute budget) -> PacketCodec.encode(message, hops = 1 for relays, ageS = now - originMs) -> TxItem.kind RESEND/RELAY
Settings resendOwn, relay, repeatHoldMin, repeatMax, repeatGapS, repeatBudget -> RadioEngine -> RepeatConfig; Settings > Channel section 'Store and forward'
emergency: TAK client b-a-* event -> cot/CotMapper.emergency -> EmergencyMessage -> Gateway.offer -> sched/EmergencyBeacon.update (and SeenCache)
Gateway.pollFrame: EmergencyBeacon.due (now, then every 30 s while active; cancel 3 times) -> TxQueue (highest priority) -> codec type 4

RF: Gateway.onRfFrame -> SeenCache (a cancel is a newer version; old alerts OUTDATED) -> rfAlerts (heardAlerts) -> CotBuilder.emergency (stale 10 min); author's repeats of an active alert are delivered every time
Relay stations: RepeatStore holds and relays alerts like chat (ranked first); own alerts are never in RepeatStore
RadioEngine.publish -> RadioStatus.ownAlerts / heardAlerts -> StatusScreen alert cards and the service notification
dataFlows.fx25: Settings.fx25 -> ModemConfig.fx25CheckBytes -> AfskModulator.modulate -> ax25/Fx25.encodeFrame (falls back to plain HDLC when too long). Receive: every AfskDemodulator slicer feeds bits to HdlcDeframer and Fx25Receiver -> ReedSolomon.decode -> HdlcDeframer on the corrected data -> deliver (CRC de-dup; fecRecovered counts frames only FX.25 got)
dataFlows.channelHealth: RadioEngine: status thread samples SoftModemTransport.state into stats/ChannelStats (busy/idle, not TX) and adds deltas of fecRecovered and Gateway.queueDropped; onRfFrame counts RfOutcome.kind; transmitLoop records lastAirtimeMs or TX_FAILED -> ChannelStats.snapshot -> RadioStatus.health -> StatusScreen. PLI loss: Gateway encodes a station-wide report counter (extension bit 5) on PLIs; receivers count gaps per source into HeardStation.pliReceived/pliMissed
dataFlows.teamProfile: Share: ui/TeamProfileUi ProfileShareDialog -> data/TeamProfiles Settings.toTeamProfile -> core profile/TeamProfile.toUri -> QR (ZXing) / net/Sharing.shareProfile / clipboard. Load: takwave://profile link (MainActivity intent filter), file (OpenDocument, 2 KB cap) or clipboard -> AppContainer.pendingProfile -> ProfileImportDialog: TeamProfile.parse + Settings.withTeamProfile + profileChanges -> Apply -> SettingsStore.update
dataFlows.hiddenCallsign: Settings.hideCallsign (effective only via Settings.callsignHidden, i.e. while encryption is on; also in TeamProfile 'hide') -> RadioEngine (only with a working cipher) -> Gateway(hideSource) -> PacketCodec.encode(hiddenSource) version 1. RF: Gateway.onRfFrame decodes, takes DecodeResult.Ok.hiddenSource as source, own-echo check after decryption; hidden traffic relayed only by hiding relays. UI: SettingsScreen EncryptionDetails switch + warning card; HelpText.ENCRYPTION; TeamProfileUi import warning. docs/PROTOCOL.md section 6 'Hidden source'
dataFlows.storeForwardPersistence: RadioEngine.startBlocking: data/StateFile.read -> Gateway.restoreState (parse fully, then apply; drops held messages if encryption or callsign hiding was switched; protection byte 0 clear / 1 encrypted / 2 hidden) ; status thread every 30 s and releaseAll on stop: Gateway.saveState -> StateFile.write when changed
dataFlows.settings: ui/SettingsScreen -> data/SettingsStore (DataStore) ; read once by service/TakwaveService when it builds RadioEngine
dataFlows.radioGuide: ui/RadioGuideScreen choices -> SettingsStore (radioService, radioBand, channelWidth, terrain; a terrain change resets the band to RadioGuide.recommendedBand, a service change coerces the width) -> core radio/RadioGuide.advise -> RadioAdvice rendered on screen ; optional 'Use this FX.25 setting' writes Settings.fx25 ; CalibrateScreen reads Settings.effectiveChannelWidth for its deviation text. Nothing reaches the gateway (docs/DECISIONS.md 104-107)
dataFlows.onboarding: MainActivity shows ui/OnboardingScreen while Settings.onboardingDone is false: welcome -> permissions -> quick-start offer -> callsign -> radio setup (USB interface / VOX cable / Bluetooth serial PTT / KISS TNC / acoustic) -> setup-specific steps -> done. Values are written straight to SettingsStore; Skip or Finish sets onboardingDone; Settings > 'Run the setup guide again' clears it
dataFlows.bluetoothPtt: Settings (btPttDevice, btPttPreset, btKeyCommand, btUnkeyCommand) -> RadioEngine.buildSoftModem -> core io/PttCommand.parse -> ptt/BluetoothPtt.open (RFCOMM SPP to a paired device, sends unkey first) -> used as Ptt by SoftModemTransport ; link loss -> RadioEngine.onBluetoothPttLost (pttLost, audio abort, warning)
dataFlows.keys: ui/SettingsScreen file picker -> data/KeyFiles.import (validates via core codec/KeyLoader) -> files/keys/* ; KeyFiles.buildCipher at gateway start
dataFlows.status: RadioEngine.publish (10 Hz) -> AppContainer.status StateFlow -> Compose screens and the service notification
dataFlows.dataPackage: ui/StatusScreen -> net/Sharing.shareDataPackage -> core datapackage/DataPackage.build -> FileProvider -> share sheet -> ATAK

build.thirdParty: com.google.zxing:core (Apache-2.0) in :app for QR generation only
